basic_profile.bio: Hey there! I'm a 32-year-old software developer living in Nashville. I've been exploring Reddit for about a year and a half now, mainly to connect with like-minded individuals and learn new things. I'm passionate about Latin American culture, especially the food and music. I love cooking up a storm in my kitchen, and when I'm not coding or experimenting with new recipes, you might find me dancing the night away at a local salsa club. I'm single and enjoy my independence, though I'm open to meeting someone who shares my interests. As a night owl, I typically browse Reddit in the late evening. Politics can be a heated topic, but I try to stay moderate and open-minded. I'm always up for a good discussion, especially on topics that challenge my perspectives.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in computer science with a Bachelor's degree from a state university. My interest in Latin American culture started in college when I took an elective in Latin American studies. I've been self-teaching ever since, through travel, cooking, and engaging with communities both online and offline.
